license_required.quote: All real estate appraisals and appraisal reviews performed on real property in this state shall be performed only by individuals who are registered, licensed or certified in accordance with the requirements of this chapter.

age_minimum.quote: Be at least eighteen years of age and a citizen of the United States or a qualified alien as defined in 8 United States Code section 1641.

moral_character_required.quote: State whether or not the applicant has ever been convicted in a court of competent jurisdiction in this or any other state of a felony or of forgery, theft, extortion or conspiracy to defraud or any other crime involving dishonesty or moral turpitude.

degree_required.quote: An applicant must complete education requirements as outlined by the appraiser qualifications board.

accrediting_body.quote: In prescribing criteria for certification, adopt criteria that at a minimum are equal to the minimum criteria for certification adopted by the appraiser qualifications board.

required.quote: Each applicant for licensure or certification shall have experience that was acquired within ten years immediately preceding the filing of the application for licensure or certification.

duration.quote: Each applicant for licensure or certification shall have experience that was acquired within ten years immediately preceding the filing of the application for licensure or certification.

kind.value: real estate or other appraisal reports, review reports or filed memoranda
kind.quote: Each applicant for licensure or certification shall furnish under oath a detailed listing of the real estate or other appraisal reports, review reports or filed memoranda for each year for which experience is claimed by the applicant.

exams.name: National Examination (AQB-approved) for state-licensed appraisers
exams.quote: A person may not be a state-licensed appraiser unless the person has achieved a passing grade on the national examination approved by the appraiser qualifications board.

exams.name: National Examination (AQB-approved) for state-certified appraisers
exams.quote: A person may not be a state-certified real estate appraiser unless the person has achieved a passing grade on the national examination approved by the appraiser qualifications board.

interval_years.quote: Except as provided in subsection B of this section, a license or certificate issued under this chapter is valid for two years from the date of issuance.

required.quote: As a prerequisite to renewal of a license or certificate, a state registered trainee appraiser or a state-licensed or state-certified appraiser shall present evidence satisfactory to the deputy director of having met the continuing education requirements of either subsection B or C of this section.

available.quote: Reciprocity shall be granted to an appraiser if all of the following conditions apply:

requirements.value: Appraiser must hold a credential from a state in compliance with specified federal statutes, the credential requirements of that state must meet or exceed those of Arizona, and the appraiser must complete an application and pay the required fees.
requirements.quote: Reciprocity shall be granted to an appraiser if all of the following conditions apply: 1. The appraiser holds a credential from a state that is in compliance with 12 United States Code sections 3310... 2. The credential requirements for the state described in paragraph 1 of this section meet or exceed those of this state. 3. The appraiser has completed an application for licensure or certification on a form as prescribed by the deputy director and submitted the fees prescribed pursuant to section 32-3607.

exists.quote: The deputy director shall adopt rules in aid or in furtherance of this chapter.

national_certification.quote: In prescribing criteria for certification, adopt criteria that at a minimum are equal to the minimum criteria for certification adopted by the appraiser qualifications board.

title_protection.quote: No person, other than a registered trainee appraiser or a state-licensed or state-certified appraiser, may assume or use that title or any title, designation or abbreviation likely to create the impression of registration as a trainee appraiser or licensure or certification as an appraiser by this state.

scope_protection.quote: All real estate appraisals and appraisal reviews performed on real property in this state shall be performed only by individuals who are registered, licensed or certified in accordance with the requirements of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or attempting to procure a license or certificate by knowingly making a false statement, submitting false information, or committing fraud or misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring or attempting to procure a license or certificate pursuant to this chapter by knowingly making a false statement, submitting false information, refusing to provide complete information in response to a question in an application for a license or certificate or committing any form of fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to meet the minimum qualifications established by this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to meet the minimum qualifications established by this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying or offering to pay money or other considerations to any member or employee of the department to procure a license or certificate.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying or offering to pay money or other considerations other than as provided by this chapter to any member or employee of the department to procure a license or certificate under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of a crime substantially related to appraisal duties, any felony, or any crime involving moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted, including based on a plea of guilty, of a crime that is substantially related to the qualifications, functions and duties of a person developing appraisals and communicating appraisals to others, or being convicted of any felony or any crime involving moral turpitude.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an act or omission involving dishonesty, fraud or misrepresentation with intent to benefit oneself or another or to injure another person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an act or omission involving dishonesty, fraud or misrepresentation with the intent to substantially benefit the license or certificate holder or another person or with the intent to substantially injure another person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any of the standards of the development or communication of appraisals as provided in this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any of the standards of the development or communication of appraisals as provided in this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being negligent or incompetent as a state-licensed or state-certified appraiser in developing an appraisal, preparing an appraisal report, or communicating an appraisal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being negligent or incompetent as a state-licensed or state-certified appraiser in developing an appraisal, in preparing an appraisal report or in communicating an appraisal.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wilfully disregarding or violating any provisions of this chapter or an order or rule of the deputy director.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilfully disregarding or violating any provisions of this chapter or an order or rule of the deputy director for the administration and enforcement of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting an appraisal assignment contingent on reporting a predetermined estimate or on the opinion, conclusion, or value reached.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting an appraisal assignment if the employment itself is contingent on the appraiser reporting a predetermined estimate, analysis or opinion or if the fee to be paid is contingent on the opinion, conclusion or value reached or on the consequences resulting from the appraisal assignment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the confidential nature of any records accessed through employment or engagement as an appraiser.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the confidential nature of any records to which the registered trainee appraiser or the state-licensed or state-certified appraiser gains access through employment or engagement as a registered trainee appraiser or an appraiser.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a final civil judgment entered against the person on grounds of fraud, misrepresentation or deceit in the making of any appraisal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a final civil judgment entered against the person on grounds of fraud, misrepresentation or deceit in the making of any appraisal.

definition_quote.value: All real estate appraisals and appraisal reviews performed on real property in this state shall be performed only by individuals who are registered, licensed or certified in accordance with the requirements of this chapter.

methods_authorized.quote: All real estate appraisals and appraisal reviews performed on real property in this state shall be performed only by individuals who are registered, licensed or certified in accordance with the requirements of this chapter.

credential_tiers.quote: 1. State-certified general real estate appraisers... 2. State-certified residential real estate appraisers... 3. State-licensed real estate appraisers... 4. Registered trainee appraisers... 5. Supervisory appraisers.

federally_related_transaction_scope.quote: The classification includes the appraisal for federally and nonfederally related transactions of vacant or unimproved land that is used for one to four family purposes or for which the highest and best use is for one to four family purposes.

nonfederally_related_transaction_scope.quote: The classification includes the appraisal for nonfederally related transactions of vacant or unimproved land that is used for one to four family purposes or for which the highest and best use is for one to four family purposes.

property_type_scope.quote: State-certified general real estate appraisers consisting of those persons meeting the requirements for certification relating to the appraisal or appraisal review of all types of real property.

trainee_supervision_required.quote: Registered trainee appraisers who may not appraise any property type without being subject to the direct control and supervision of the registered trainee appraiser's designated supervisory appraiser.

temporary_practice_permitted.quote: A nonresident of this state who is licensed or certified in another state is entitled to nonresident temporary licensure or certification by the deputy director, which is valid until the completion of each appraisal assignment but not for a period of more than one year after the date of issuance

value: The nonresident appraiser's business in this state is of a temporary nature.
The nonresident appraiser applies with the deputy director on forms prescribed by the deputy director.
The nonresident appraiser pays the nonresident temporary licensure or certification fee required by the deputy director.
temporary_practice_conditions.quote: A nonresident of this state who is licensed or certified in another state is entitled to nonresident temporary licensure or certification by the deputy director, which is valid until the completion of each appraisal assignment but not for a period of more than one year after the date of issuance, if: 1. The nonresident appraiser's business in this state is of a temporary nature. 2. The nonresident appraiser applies with the deputy director on forms prescribed by the deputy director. 3. The nonresident appraiser pays the nonresident temporary licensure or certification fee required by the deputy director.

contingent_fee_prohibited.quote: A state-licensed or state-certified appraiser may not accept a fee for an appraisal assignment that is contingent on the appraiser reporting a predetermined estimate, analysis or opinion or that is contingent on the opinion, conclusion or value reached or on the consequences resulting from the appraisal assignment.

revocation_reinstatement_waiting_period_.quote: Not have had a license or certificate revoked pursuant to this chapter within five years immediately preceding the application.

appraisal_standards_reference.value: Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice (USPAP)
appraisal_standards_reference.quote: The uniform standards of professional appraisal practice as published by the appraisal standards board are the standards for the appraisal practice in this state unless the deputy director objects.

qualifications_board_reference.quote: In prescribing criteria for certification, adopt criteria that at a minimum are equal to the minimum criteria for certification adopted by the appraiser qualifications board.
